name: lesson-extractor
description: Parse a session interaction or task result and extract a structured lesson with root cause, fix, and severity.

inputs.name: interaction_text
inputs.description: The task description, error output, or interaction to analyze

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.description: The session ID this lesson belongs to

outputs.name: lesson
outputs.description: Structured lesson object with timestamp, summary, root_cause, fix, severity
